changes.title: Mesh batch e
items: The cold-blooded animals are redrawn as low-poly models on skeletons: salamander, Komodo dragon, crocodile, toad, armadillo, jungle python and rattlesnake, each with its own baby, young, adult and legend, at the sizes they were
The snakes slither: their curves stay put on the ground as they pass through them, and they coil up to sleep with their heads on top
The salamander, Komodo dragon and crocodile walk sprawled, legs out to their sides and their backs swinging; the toad hops; the armadillo scurries under a banded shell

Their legends wear plate armour cut with glowing runes: a salamander crested with flame, a mossed stone Komodo, a crocodile with standing stones down its back, a hooded python, a horned rattlesnake with a great rattle

changes.title: Mesh batch d
items: The bear, polar bear, rhino, elephant, beaver and flying squirrel are new low-poly models: they stride with planted feet, the elephant has a trunk that swings and ears like sails, the rhino's horn grows as it does, the beaver has its paddle of a tail and the flying squirrel its glide skin. Their legends wear rune-lit armour.

changes.title: Taut chain smooth
items: Pulling a creature's chain from the treetops now brings you down to the ground in one smooth glide, with no drop at the end; let go at any height and you rise again

changes.title: Sleep eyelids
items: Going to sleep at the bed now closes her eyes: the screen darkens from the edges as you hold, and opens again if you let go early
Waking up in the morning, her eyes open the same way

changes.title: Makeup one colour
items: Makeup at the basin is now one colour for your lips and eyes together: pick a colour to put it on, pick the same colour again to take it off
Blush is gone; if you were wearing it, it comes off
